## 0) preparations

### Data / Description

- *This script will generate the following plot:*

  *- Supp Fig 1 D*

### Initialize R

```{r message=FALSE}
#| label: initialize

library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(einprot)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```

### Load data

```{r}
#| label: load-data and center

# To generate the needed file, first run the script "Einprot_Output.R"

sce_file <- "wo_S07_S08_S11_S12_CScore7/Spectronaut_4758_PG.Quantity_MinProbGlobal_center.median.shared_limma_einprot0.10.2_sce.rds"

sce <- readRDS(sce_file)


norm.counts <- assay(sce, "log2_PG.Quantity_norm")
dim(norm.counts)

norm.counts.c <- t(scale(t(norm.counts),center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))
```

### Select genes

```{r}
#| label: genes of interest

# Gene list

gene_list_1 <- c("CDH1","CGA","CGB3","CSH1","GDF15",
                 "PSG1","PSG2","PSG3","PSG4","PSG5","PSG6","PSG9",
                 "FLT1","LAMC1","NID1","NID2","VIM","HSD17B1","ERVFRD-1","GFPT1")

# check presence
length(gene_list_1)

sum(gene_list_1 %in% rownames(norm.counts))

```

## 1) Prepare the matrix

```{r}
#| label: prepare-matrix

#center and scale
norm.counts.cs <- t(scale(t(norm.counts),center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))

# and now select
norm.counts.c.sel1 <- norm.counts.c[rownames(norm.counts.c) %in% gene_list_1,c(2:4,6:8)]
norm.counts.c.sel1 <- norm.counts.c.sel1[match(gene_list_1, rownames(norm.counts.c.sel1)),]

```

## 2) Plot

```{r}
tiff("Sfigure1d.tiff",
     width = 2000,
     height = 6000,
     res = 300)

Heatmap(norm.counts.c.sel1, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE) 

dev.off()
```

## 3) sessionInfo

```{r}
#| label: sessionInfo
sessionInfo()
```
